verdict.rationale: Terraform is a CLI that runs fully non-interactively. `-auto-approve` skips interactive approval, saved `-out` plan files can be applied later, `-var`/`-var-file` supply inputs, and `-json` gives machine-readable plan/apply/test output and state inspection. A community user reports rebuilding whole environments automatically, which corroborates unattended use. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party guide for running in CI/automation pipelines (e.g. environment-based non-interactive settings) and explicit hands-on CI pipeline corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can pass the `-auto-approve` option to instruct Terraform to apply the plan without asking for confirmation.
You can use the optional `-out=FILE` option to save the generated plan to a file on disk, which you can later execute by passing the file to `terraform apply`
For long-running commands such as `plan`, `apply`, `refresh`, and `test`, the `-json` flag outputs a stream of JSON UI messages.
The CLI usage and output of the state commands is structured to be friendly for Unix tools such as grep, awk, etc.
